items.summary: Re-uploaded my comment on the game. It is great, the gameplay, the dark lore, everything is great. But after 40 hours in this game i got an problem related to the optimization. I believe my device (Samsung A36, 6 ram, one ui 8.5) would run better this game. I tried to lower the settings but the game always feels it would crash every moment. Despite my good wifi, it still downloads slowly. That's my problem, the optimization. Thanks you and keep up the good work.
